name: Tauranga Yoga Centre
reason: Not an Iyengar school in practice and no usable photo. The volunteer-run community centre (since 1975, 173 Elizabeth Street West) lists one certified Iyengar teacher (Curly West) among teachers of hatha, IYTA and yin yoga, and its events are a mix (yin, 9D breathwork, sound, movement), with a restorative class for women with cancer. It is a Wix site: all images sit on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request, so no photo could be used. robots.txt of the site itself is open; email info@taurangayoga.org.nz and a contact form are published. Owner may still want it as a general community yoga centre if a photo can be sourced.
